lines: Likewise, for the arising of both-natured
contemplation, by disregard alone of states
divided by outer, inner, knowable-forms: that
l4.sanskrit_cite: tathā ubhayātmakaparāmarśodayārthaṃ bāhyābhyantarādiprameyarūpabhinnabhāvānapekṣayaiva evaṃvidhaṃ tat paraṃ tattvaṃ svasvabhāvabhūtam iti antaḥ parāmarśanaṃ japaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is japa here? → Japa = antaḥ-parāmarśana with bāhya/abhyantara-bheda disregarded — both-aspect contemplation.
c1_essence: Japa: inner contemplation of own-nature-tattva, disregarding outer/inner-knowable divisions.
reads_against.c1_rasa: karuṇā with vīrya weight (compassion carrying fierce argument)
